overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、金融科技（1 篇）、收入分配与福利（1 篇）。方法上以回归分析、模型校准为主。来源分布：arXiv（8 篇）、OpenAlex（2 篇）、NBER（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Human-AI Collaboration in Urban Digital Transformation: Balancing Efficiency and Human Values in Shanghai’s AI-Enabled Talent Recruitment
papers.abstract: In the context of the urban digital revolution, recruitment through AI technologies has become common practice to address competition in the labor market. However, it is still unclear how the effectiveness of such recruitment is connected with humanistic values. For this research, an exploratory qualitative research design was used, involving semi-structured interviews with eight human resource professionals in Shanghai. Based on the results, the use of AI in recruitment led to increased efficiency mainly when screening candidates through high-volume, standardized processes, although the promised efficiency was not delivered in practice because the introduction of the AI system increased the workload. Patterns of human-machine cooperation were observed in different companies: tech companies and foreign companies are inclined to adopt interactive adjustment approaches, while state-owned enterprises retain human-dominated decision-making. Transparency of algorithms was still lacking in numerous instances, and there was an asymmetry in the accountability framework of algorithms, wherein disobeying algorithms carries more personal consequences than obeying them. The more experienced professionals became more autonomous in their work, while the less experienced professionals depended more on the algorithm. Issues like management support, information accuracy, and departmental integration have a major impact on implementation. This study contributes to the theory of human-machine collaboration by proposing the concept of asymmetric algorithmic accountability, which captures the uneven distribution of organizational consequences for following versus overriding AI recommendations and shapes practitioner behavior in ways that extend beyond individual trust or algorithmic transparency.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】在城市数字化革命的背景下，利用人工智能技术进行招聘已成为应对劳动力市场竞争的常见做法。然而，这种招聘方式的有效性与人文价值观之间的关联仍不明确。为此，本研究采用了探索性定性研究方法，对上海的八位人力资源专业人士进行了半结构化访谈。研究结果表明，人工智能在招聘中的应用主要提高了筛选候选人的效率，尤其是在处理大量标准化流程时；不过实际操作中并未实现预期的效率提升，因为人工智能系统的引入反而增加了工作负担。在不同类型的企业中观察到了人机协作的模式：科技公司及外资企业更倾向于采用交互式调整策略，而国有企业则仍以人为主导的决策方式为主。在许多情况下，算法的透明度仍然不足，且算法的问责机制存在不对称性——违反算法规定所带来的个人后果比遵守算法更为严重。经验丰富的专业人士在工作中表现出更高的自主性，而经验不足的专业人士则更依赖算法的决策结果。管理支持、信息准确性以及部门间的协同等因素对人工智能招聘的实施效果具有重要影响。本研究通过提出“不对称算法问责”这一概念，为探讨人机协作理论做出了贡献。该概念揭示了在遵循或无视人工智能建议时，组织所承担后果的分配不均现象，并进一步阐释了从业者的行为模式，这...。

papers.title: Biaya Modal, Profitabilitas, dan Efisiensi Aktivitas Operasi terhadap Nilai Perusahaan Sektor Teknologi di BEI
papers.abstract:
Purpose— This study aims to examine the effect of cost of capital, profitability, and operational activity efficiency on firm value among technology sector companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) during the 2023–2025 period.
Design/methodology— This study employs a quantitative approach using secondary data obtained from the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The sample was determined using a purposive sampling method, resulting in 54 observations from technology sector companies during the 2023–2025 period. The independent variables consist of cost of capital, profitability, and operational activity efficiency, while firm value is the dependent variable. Data analysis was performed using multiple linear regression with the assistance of SPSS version 27.
Findings— The results indicate that cost of capital has a significant positive effect on firm value. Profitability has a significant positive effect on firm value, indicating that higher profitability reflects better company performance and prospects, thereby increasing investor confidence and firm value. Operational activity efficiency also has a significant positive effect on firm value, indicating that companies that efficiently utilize their assets to generate sales tend to have higher firm value.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本研究旨在考察资本成本、盈利能力及运营活动效率对2023-2025年期间印尼证券交易所科技公司企业价值的影响。

🔬 研究方法：研究采用定量方法，利用SPSS 27软件对来自印尼证券交易所的二手数据进行多元线性回归分析，样本由54家科技公司构成。

📊 核心发现：研究发现，资本成本、盈利能力及运营活动效率均对企业价值产生显著的正向影响，表明更高的盈利能力和资产利用效率能提升投资者信心并增加公司价值。

💡 应用价值：该研究为投资者和管理层提供了重要参考，揭示了提升资本效率、盈利能力和运营效率对于增强企业市场价值的重要性。

papers.title: Unconfoundedness as an Information Constraint
papers.abstract: This paper provides an information-theoretic characterization of unconfoundedness within a general class of models allowing for endogenous selection. We impose a conditional mutual information (CMI) restriction requiring that the information about treatment contained in a potential outcome, conditional on covariates, does not exceed that contained in its latent heterogeneity. Under the maintained model conditions, this restriction is equivalent to a multiplicative factorization of treatment probabilities into separate functions of latent heterogeneity and covariates. Although the CMI restriction permits endogenous selection, sufficiently rich variation in treatment probabilities across covariate values makes it equivalent to unconfoundedness for the corresponding potential outcome. For binary treatments, any nonconstant propensity score suffices; for multiple treatments, a full-rank condition on the second-moment matrix of the propensity-score vector is sufficient. State-specific restrictions bound residual selection and imply exogeneity for individual treatment states under boundary-support conditions. Extensions cover continuous treatments and instrument exogeneity.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文从信息论的角度对一类允许内生选择的模型中的无混杂性进行了刻画。我们提出了一个条件互信息（CMI）约束，要求在给定协变量的条件下，潜在结果中包含的治疗信息量不得超过其中潜在异质性所包含的信息量。在保持模型条件的情况下，这一约束等价于将治疗概率分解为潜在异质性和协变量的函数。尽管CMI约束允许内生选择，但只要治疗概率在协变量值上存在足够丰富的变化，就意味着相应的潜在结果具有无混杂性。对于二元治疗，任何非恒定的倾向得分都满足要求；对于多重治疗，倾向得分向量的二阶矩矩阵需要满足满秩条件。特定状态的约束可以限制残差选择，并在边界支持条件下确保各个治疗状态的外生性。本文的扩展内容涵盖了连续治疗和工具变量外生性的情况。。研究方法：倾向得分匹配。

papers.title: Symbol-based residual certification of reduced and neural surrogates for tempered-fractional CGMY pricing
papers.abstract: We certify reduced and neural approximations of European-put price trajectories under the Carr--Geman--Madan--Yor model by residual bounds for the spline Galerkin discretisation of the tempered-fractional pricing equation. The Galerkin matrices are Toeplitz sections of an explicit periodised Fourier symbol; summing the alias series to a stated tail makes the assembled system exact to $10^{-8}$. A Lévy--Khintchine argument gives the parameter-explicit bound $λ_{\min}(S_I)\ge r\,m_{\min}$ for the symmetric part, valid for $Y\in(0,2)\setminus\{1\}$, replacing numerical spectral estimates. A banded comparison norm built from the mass and stiffness symbols yields a rigorous certificate at $O(N)$ cost with explicit effectivity, and empirical interpolation of the symbol makes the operator affine in about 36 terms with a rigorous error transfer, so a reduced model is certified at a cost independent of $N$; a three-stage rule escalates to the full-order bounds only when needed. At the resolution that prices the whole parameter box to one cent ($N=1024$), the full-order certificate costs 6% of a direct solve, and the certified POD--Galerkin model of rank 80 costs 3% of it and settles 99.8% of $10^4$ queries without touching the full space. No false accept occurs on any query with a reference solution (150 inside the parameter box, 264 outside), and outside the box the certificate accepts 193 of the 210 queries on which the reduced model is still within one cent. The neural reduced models trained here miss the one-cent tolerance by a factor of at least 46; the certificate detects this at every query in a few milliseconds and explains it as a trade-off between temporal smoothness and coefficient accuracy. A residual certificate for the American put is proved as an outlook.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们通过残差界限方法，对Carr–Geman–Madan–Yor模型下的欧式看跌期权价格轨迹的简化模型及神经网络近似模型进行了验证。该方法基于样条Galerkin离散化技术，用于处理具有温度分数特征的定价方程。Galerkin矩阵是显式周期性傅里叶符号的Toeplitz子矩阵；通过对混叠序列进行求和处理（直至指定的尾部范围），整个离散化系统的误差可控制在$10^{-8}$以内。Lévy–Khintchine理论为对称部分提供了参数显式的误差界限$\lambda_{\min}(S_I)\ge r\,m_{\min}$，该结论适用于$Y\in(0,2)\setminus\{1\}$区间，从而无需依赖数值谱估计。基于质量和刚度符号构建的带状比较范数能够在$O(N)$的计算成本下提供严格的误差证明，并确保算法的有效性。通过对符号进行经验插值处理，算子可以被表示为大约36个项的仿射函数，从而实现精确的误差传递；因此简化模型的验证成本与数据量$N$无关。只有在必要时，才会采用三阶段算法来获得完整阶数的误差界限。在将整个参数区间内的价格精度控制在1美分以内的情况下（$N=1024$），完整阶数...。

papers.title: Saving for the Machines
papers.abstract: When machines can perform a growing share of tasks, growth depends on two margins: how the task structure affects the returns to accumulating machines, and how strongly capital accumulation responds to those returns. I argue that, in a standard task model, capital supply governs the size of the growth boom associated with automation, while the task structure sets the duration of this growth boom and the evolution of wages. I document how the same technology path that generates 11.7% annual growth when households choose their saving rate optimally delivers only 2.2% when the saving rate is fixed at the calibrated U.S. 2025 level of 23%. Therefore, slow growth might reflect too little capital accumulation instead of a technological bottleneck. Also, the saving rate rises mainly because automation raises the capital share, not because households become thriftier. Long yields price the growth boom: the ten-year real yield jumps from 5.1% to 13.6% on impact. In my benchmark calibration, hand-to-mouth households lose the equivalent of two-fifths to two-thirds of their consumption, while keeping them on trend temporarily costs at most a fifth of GDP.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】当机器能够承担越来越多的任务时，经济增长取决于两个关键因素：任务结构如何影响对机器投资的回报，以及资本积累对这些回报的反应程度。我认为，在标准的任务模型中，资本供应决定了自动化带来的经济增长高峰的规模；而任务结构则决定了这一增长高峰的持续时间以及工资水平的演变。研究表明，当家庭能够根据最优策略选择储蓄率时，同样的技术路径能够带来11.7%的年增长率；但如果将储蓄率固定在2025年美国的水平（23%）上，这一增长率仅为2.2%。因此，经济增长缓慢可能更多地反映了资本积累不足，而非技术瓶颈。此外，储蓄率的上升主要是由于自动化提高了资本在总收入中的占比，而非家庭变得更加节俭。长期来看，这种技术变革会对经济增长产生显著影响：十年期实际收益率从5.1%跃升至13.6%。在我的基准情景下，那些只能勉强维持基本生活的家庭会失去相当于其消费总额五分之二到三分之二的收入；而若暂时维持这些家庭的现有生活水平，最多只需要花费GDP的五分之一。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Income Inequality and Intergenerational Mobility in Russia: Trends, Sources, and Measurement
papers.abstract: This chapter documents trends in income and inequality in Russia from the collapse of the Soviet Union through 2025, drawing on official statistics, the existing literature, and household survey microdata. It also reviews evidence on intergenerational mobility. While there is a consensus that inequality dramatically increased during the 1990s, its post-2000 trajectory is contested. Initial household survey studies usually found a decline, whereas official statistics reported a comparatively stable Gini coefficient. Our analysis of Russia's major household surveys, harmonized using common measurement conventions, aligns with the survey-based literature, indicating that the Gini coefficient generally fell from approximately 0.45–0.48 in the early 2000s to 0.29–0.38 in the early 2020s. We further find that most inequality arises within rather than between regions, urban and rural areas, and education and occupation groups. Household labor-market attachment, region, and household composition account for the largest shares of the explained variance in log income. The large literature on inequality is complemented by a small literature on intergenerational mobility. Here, the various studies on intergenerational dynamics in education, occupation, and income across post-Soviet cohorts conclude that, even against the background of dramatic structural changes, family background remains strongly associated with children’s outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】本章基于官方统计数据、现有文献以及家庭调查微观数据，记录了自苏联解体至2025年间俄罗斯收入与不平等状况的发展趋势。同时，本章也回顾了有关代际流动性的研究证据。尽管普遍认为20世纪90年代不平等现象急剧加剧，但21世纪00年代之后的发展趋势仍存在争议：早期的家庭调查结果显示不平等程度有所下降，而官方统计数据显示基尼系数相对稳定。通过对俄罗斯主要家庭调查数据的分析（这些数据采用了统一的测量标准），我们发现基尼系数从21世纪初的约0.45–0.48下降到了2020年代初的0.29–0.38。进一步研究发现，大多数不平等现象存在于不同地区、城乡之间，以及不同教育水平和职业群体之间。家庭劳动力市场参与情况、地区因素以及家庭构成结构能够解释收入差异中的大部分变化。关于不平等现象的丰富研究文献之外，关于代际流动性的研究相对较少。现有研究表明，尽管社会结构发生了巨大变化，家庭背景仍然对子女的就业和收入状况具有重要影响。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Penalize the Common Trade: A Collision-Aware Layer for Learned Portfolios
papers.abstract: Different learning systems can make nearly the same trade when they share data, objectives, or representations. The market then sees decision concentration even if the models look diverse. We call exposure to this shared direction a signal collision. A linear-impact game shows the basic externality: each allocator chooses too much common exposure because it does not bear the full price effect imposed on others. An overlap-dependent toll recovers the social choice, and a feedback model gives the exact gain at which return-responsive allocation becomes unstable. We also state the restrictive spectral conditions under which a leading eigenportfolio can reveal the collision direction. These results motivate a simple post-model layer: subtract a penalty for loading on the recent common return mode before forming the portfolio. In a frozen panel of ten liquid cross-asset ETFs, 760 completed weeks from January 2012 through July 2026, and exact self-financing costs of 10 basis points per dollar traded, this layer changes maximum drawdown from 23.6% to 14.1%, volatility from 12.6% to 10.7%, and excess-return Sharpe from 0.664 to 0.667. A volatility-matched momentum diagnostic still draws down 19.9%. Paired stationary-bootstrap uncertainty is wide: the 95% interval for drawdown improvement is $[-3.3,18.4]$ percentage points and includes zero. The result establishes a reproducible risk-control association and specifies the holdings-and-flow validation needed to attribute the common direction to AI crowding. AI-use disclosure. Generative AI tools, including OpenAI Codex, assisted manuscript preparation. For this preprint version, Codex assisted with LaTeX editing, author and venue metadata, compilation, and layout checks.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】不同的学习系统在共享数据、目标或表示方式时，几乎可以实现相同的效果。即使模型看起来各不相同，市场仍会观察到决策的集中现象。我们将这种共享趋势称为“信号冲突”。线性影响模型揭示了这一基本的外部性：每个决策者都会选择过多的共同投资组合，因为他们无需承担这种决策对他人造成的全部负面影响。通过引入依赖重叠度的收费机制，可以恢复社会最优选择；而反馈模型则能够精确指出在何种收益水平下，基于收益的分配策略会变得不稳定。我们还提出了相应的条件，说明在何种情况下，一个主导性的投资组合能够揭示这种信号冲突的方向。这些研究结果促使我们提出了一种简单的模型改进方法：在构建投资组合之前，对那些过度依赖近期共同收益模式的投资进行惩罚。在2012年1月至2026年7月期间，选取了10只流动性较强的跨资产交易型开放式指数基金（ETF）的数据（共760个完整交易周），假设每美元交易量的自筹资金成本为10个基点，采用该方法后，最大回撤率从23.6%降至14.1%，波动率从12.6%降至10.7%，超额收益的夏普比率从0.664提升至0.667。不过，即使采用波动率匹配的动量策略，最大回撤率仍能达到19.9%。此外，...。

papers.title: On inverse aggregate network assignment games
papers.abstract: To design platforms for multi-operator mobility markets coordinating their operations or infrastructure to support them, models are needed to understand the behavior of these operators and travelers in a shared network. Assignment games can prove useful, but operationalizing them requires adopting a more generalized aggregate assignment game framework that allows for identification and estimation. We extend such a framework to aggregate network assignment games, proposing a path-based formulation and a PURC-based formulation along with solution algorithms. An inverse optimization model is proposed for the link-based formulation. It is solved by a quadratic program that separates into a buyer block, which retains the node potentials and imposes every observed zero-flow cell, and a seller block. This estimator, introduced in the literature for uncapacitated route choice, is extended here to a capacitated two-sided market, with rationing prices supported on observed binding links and operator supply scales estimated by group. Computational tests with a toy network demonstrate the economic value of these models. A large-scale Long Island Rail Road network example (897 nodes, 671 census tracts, 123 LIRR stations, 8,320 directed links) is calibrated to 2026 fares, timetabled seat supply and National Transit Database operating costs. With 10-50% of links sampled, the misspecified inverse model fits oracle link flows with R^2>=96%. Held-out link error falls from 29% to 19%, correlations with the true rationing prices rise from 49% to 75%, and social optimal gross surplus is recovered within 6%. Deadweight loss is overestimated by 10-17%. Ablation tests show that ignoring the inactive cells more than doubles the held-out error and, at 30-50% sampling, roughly halves the correlation of the pricing wedge, while ignoring the rationing prices degrades every metric.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】为了设计用于多运营商移动市场的平台，以协调这些运营商的运营或基础设施，需要建立模型来理解它们在共享网络中的行为。分配博弈（assignment games）在这方面可以发挥重要作用，但将其实际应用起来需要采用一种更为通用的聚合分配博弈框架，以便能够对相关数据进行识别和估算。我们扩展了这种框架，提出了基于路径的分配博弈模型以及基于PURC（Probabilistic Utility Routing Criterion）的分配博弈模型，并配套相应的求解算法。对于基于链接的分配模型，我们提出了一个逆向优化模型，该模型通过一个二次规划问题进行求解，该问题分为两个部分：买方部分保留节点的潜在状态并规定所有观测到的零流量节点；卖方部分则负责制定价格。这种用于无容量限制路径选择的估算方法被扩展到了有容量限制的双边市场中，其中价格制定基于观测到的有效链接情况，而运营商的供应规模则通过分组方式进行估算。通过在一个小型网络上的计算测试，验证了这些模型的经济价值。我们以长岛铁路网络（包含897个节点、671个普查区域、123个车站和8,320条有向链接）为例，根据2026年的票价、时刻表座位供应情况以...。研究方法：模型校准、优化方法。

papers.title: Specification LASSO and a Flexible Characteristics-Based Asset Pricing Model
papers.abstract: This paper studies a partially linear semiparametric additive model that allows for interactions among variables in high-dimensional settings. We propose the Specification LASSO (S-LASSO), a two-step method that integrates LASSO and Adaptive Group LASSO to simultaneously perform variable selection and model specification. Theoretically, we establish that S-LASSO possesses oracle properties in terms of selection consistency and asymptotic normality. Monte Carlo simulations confirm that S-LASSO outperforms existing alternatives across a variety of scenarios. Empirically, we apply S-LASSO to a characteristics-based asset pricing model, exploring the linear and nonlinear effects of asset-specific characteristics on cross-sectional returns, as well as their interactions with firm size.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本文研究了一种部分线性的半参数加性模型，该模型能够处理高维数据中变量之间的交互作用。我们提出了 Specification LASSO（S-LASSO），这是一种结合了 LASSO 和 Adaptive Group LASSO 的两步方法，用于同时进行变量选择和模型设定。从理论上讲，我们证明了 S-LASSO 在变量选择的一致性和渐近正态性方面具有优良的性能。蒙特卡洛模拟结果表明，在多种情景下，S-LASSO 的表现优于现有的其他方法。在实证研究中，我们将 S-LASSO 应用于基于资产特征的定价模型，探讨了资产特定特征对横截面回报的线性及非线性影响，以及这些特征与企业规模之间的交互作用。。研究方法：横截面分析、蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟、LASSO 正则化。

papers.title: Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
papers.abstract: Financial research agents can generate and monitor trading rules faster than a human can document the resulting selection process. Candidates appear at data-dependent times, weak rules are abandoned, and promising ones are watched until they cross a reporting threshold. We introduce PROMOTE, a protocol that assigns every candidate predictable testing wealth at birth and accumulates a cost-aware e-process only from subsequent returns. If lifetime allocations sum to at most one, a weighted Ville argument bounds the probability of ever promoting a rule whose declared bounded net score has always had nonpositive conditional mean. The result permits dependent candidates, adaptive births, and indefinite monitoring. We audit the implementation in two settings. A retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample replay contains 24 panel--rule hypotheses, 3,000 shared-sign null paths, injected alternatives, and public ETF and industry data. Repeated unadjusted tests produce a family crossing in 94.5% of null paths, versus 0.0% for PROMOTE; at a 15-bp aligned ETF-component perturbation, PROMOTE has 70.1% target power and median crossing session 2,327. A separate exact mean-zero experiment lets an agent select candidate identities and birth times from past scores; the funded gate has 1.77% false-family crossings across 3,000 programs. The market replay produces zero promotions after costs. The certificate controls historical false promotion under the declared null; it is not a certificate that an earlier edge remains profitable at deployment. AI-use disclosure. Generative AI tools, including OpenAI Codex, assisted manuscript preparation. For this preprint version, Codex assisted with LaTeX editing, author and venue metadata, compilation, and layout checks.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】金融研究代理能够比人类更快地生成和监控交易规则。候选规则会在数据驱动的时机出现，表现不佳的规则会被立即淘汰，而具有潜力的规则则会持续被观察，直到它们达到某个报告阈值。我们提出了PROMOTE协议，该协议为每个候选规则在初始阶段分配一个可预测的测试资金，并仅根据后续的回报来累积与成本相关的评估信息。如果整个生命周期内的资金分配总额不超过一个固定值，那么Ville的加权论证可以用来限制那些其声明的净收益条件均值始终为负的规则被提升的概率。这一机制允许存在相互依赖的候选规则、动态的规则生成过程以及无限制的监控机制。我们在两种不同的环境中对PROMOTE协议的实现进行了验证：一种回顾性的伪样本外回放实验包含了24个规则假设、3,000条具有相同符号的零假设路径、人为引入的替代方案以及公开的ETF数据和行业数据；在重复进行未调整的测试中，有94.5%的零假设路径出现了规则交叉现象，而PROMOTE协议仅实现了0.0%的交叉率；当ETF成分数据发生15个基点的扰动时，PROMOTE协议的目标检测能力达到了70.1%，并在第2,327个测试周期内实现了规则交叉。另一项精确的实验中，代理可以根据...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Sharp Identification for Regression with Interval-Observed and Missing Covariates
papers.abstract: Researchers frequently estimate regressions when key variables are missing or observed only through intervals. Imputation or assumptions about the observation process can yield seemingly precise but misleading conclusions. We develop methods for identification and inference that remain robust to such incomplete data. For a broad class of conditional moment models, we characterize the sharp identified set, the set of all parameter values consistent with the observed data and maintained regression model, without restricting how incomplete observations arise. We establish Hausdorff-consistent estimation and uniformly valid confidence regions, and develop computationally tractable implementations for common regression models. In an application relating interval-elicited discount rates to on-time high-school graduation, conventional inference excludes zero, whereas our interval-data-robust confidence regions include it. Exploiting sharp identification nevertheless yields substantially tighter confidence regions than non-sharp alternatives.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】当关键变量缺失或仅以区间形式观测到时，研究人员经常需要进行回归分析。通过插补或对观测过程做出假设，虽然可以得到看似精确的结论，但这些结论可能具有误导性。我们开发了能够在数据不完整的情况下依然保持稳健性的识别与推断方法。对于一类广泛的条件矩模型，我们定义了“精确识别集”——即所有与观测数据一致且回归模型保持不变的参数值集合，同时不对观测数据的缺失方式做出任何限制。我们建立了具有Hausdorff一致性的估计方法以及统一有效的置信区间，并为常见的回归模型设计了计算上可行的实现方案。在一个将区间估计的折现率与高中按时毕业率相关联的应用研究中，传统推断方法会排除折现率为零的情况，而我们基于区间数据的置信区间则允许这种情况存在。尽管存在这种不确定性，利用精确识别方法得到的置信区间仍然比非精确识别方法得到的置信区间更为精确。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: EventGPT: Next-Event Pretraining on Banking Customer Histories
papers.abstract: A model pretrained to predict a customer's next event can estimate the probability of future events without training on their labels and provide a reusable representation for supervised downstream banking tasks. We pretrain EventGPT, a hierarchical causal transformer, by next-token maximum likelihood estimation on the public Multimodal Banking Dataset (MBD-mini: 100,224 clients, 38.8 million transactions and 66.3 million geolocation pings). Keeping one state per event, EventGPT trains in about two hours on one L4 GPU at windows up to 8,192 tokens. From its next-event distribution, with no labels, EventGPT scores five targets of the form "the client makes a transaction of a given kind for the first time next month" at ROC-AUC 0.79 to 0.92. Gradient boosting on 114 engineered features needs 10,000 to 300,000 labeled client-months to match it on four targets and stays below it on the fifth. For product prediction, frozen EventGPT embeddings score below the engineered features (mean ROC-AUC 0.787 against 0.808 over five test folds), and a rank-averaged ensemble of EventGPT, profile fields and token counts with the engineered features adds 0.014 to 0.017, of which 0.007 to 0.016 is EventGPT's own. The code and pretrained weights are released.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文提出了一种预训练模型，该模型能够预测客户的后续行为事件。这种模型无需使用带有标签的数据进行训练，即可估算未来事件的概率，并为监督式下游银行任务提供可复用的数据表示。我们通过使用公开的多模态银行数据集（MBD-mini：包含100,224位客户、3880万笔交易记录以及6630万条地理位置信息）对EventGPT（一种分层因果变换器模型）进行预训练，训练方法采用基于下一个词元的最大似然估计算法。在每次事件仅保留一个状态的情况下，EventGPT仅需约两小时的时间，利用L4级别的GPU在最大8,192个词元的窗口范围内完成训练。在没有任何标签的情况下，该模型能够以0.79至0.92的ROC-AUC分数准确预测五种类型的事件（例如“客户下个月首次进行某种类型的交易”）。通过对114个人工构建的特征进行梯度提升训练，虽然需要1万到30万条带有标签的客户交易记录数据才能在四个预测目标上达到与EventGPT相当的水平，但在第五个目标上的表现仍低于EventGPT。在产品预测任务中，仅使用预训练的EventGPT嵌入特征得到的预测结果（平均ROC-AUC为0.787）低于人工构建的特征（...。研究方法：最大似然估计、梯度提升、Transformer 模型。
